connections.observation: The hunt (s001: κυνηγέτας, θάμνον, κύκλῳ περιίστασθαι) requires seeing (s002: κατιδεῖν, ἴδῃς, καθορᾶν), but the terrain (s005: δύσβατος, ἐπίσκιος, σκοτεινός, δυσδιερεύνητος) resists both movement and vision. The three vocabularies together make the section's opening predicament visible: the quarry requires encirclement, the hunt requires sight, but darkness and difficult ground impede both.

The spatial contrast πρὸ ποδῶν / πόρρω (s003) is enacted in the image of searching for what one already holds (s004: ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν ἔχοντες ζητοῦσιν). Together they make visible a double misdirection: looking far when the object is near, searching outside when it is already in hand.

Justice moves from threatened invisibility (s008: ἀφανισθεῖσα ἄδηλος) through declared visibility (φανερόν, φαίνεται) to the fire-stick image (s013: ἐκ πυρείων ἐκλάμψαι), where rubbing city and individual makes justice flash forth. The progression from darkness (ἀφανισθεῖσα) to flashing light (ἐκλάμψαι) moves through intermediate stages of appearing (φαίνεται) to anticipated full brightness (φανερὰν γενομένην).

The section opens in a δύσβατος, ἐπίσκιος, σκοτεινός, δυσδιερεύνητος place (s005) and closes with fire-sticks making justice flash forth (s013: ἐκ πυρείων ἐκλάμψαι). The shadowy, dark opening terrain is answered by the closing image of struck light.

The leader-follower negotiation (s010: ἕπου / ἡγοῦ, with Glaucon offering to follow and see what is shown, Socrates commanding him to follow, Glaucon asking Socrates to lead) is enacted again in the movement between city and individual (s018: ἐπαναφέρωμεν εἰς τὸν ἕνα, ἐπανιόντες ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν). Both passages configure a guided seeing through deliberate movement between positions.

The double appearance of ἐξ ἀρχῆς (s011) joins two beginnings: justice rolling at their feet ἐξ ἀρχῆς and the principle laid down ἐξ ἀρχῆς when founding the city. This conjunction is completed by s015's method of remainder (τὸ ὑπόλοιπον, τὸ ὑπολειφθέν): what was present from the beginning becomes visible only as what is left after finding the other three.

τὰ αὑτοῦ πράττειν (s006) is defined against πολυπραγμονεῖν, which is equated with κακουργία and ἀδικία (s007), and the μετα- compounds (s017: μεταλαμβάνω, μεταβολή, μεταλλάττω) articulate the specific movements that constitute πολυπραγμοσύνη. Together these make visible that injustice is not simply wrongdoing but a particular kind of exchange, interchange, and role-crossing.

Three δυσ- compounds mark difficulty (s012: δύσβατος terrain, δυσδιερεύνητος search, δύσκριτον judgment), and the carpenter/cobbler contrast (s016) distinguishes between minor harm (οὐ πάνυ μέγα βλάψαι) and destruction (ὄλεθρον). The conjunction makes visible that difficulty belongs both to the hunt for justice and to the judgment among virtues, while harm admits of degree depending on which boundaries are crossed.

The hunt begins with the fear that justice will escape (s001: διαφύγῃ, ἐκφευξεῖσθαι) and become invisible (ἀφανισθεῖσα ἄδηλος), then declares it will not escape (οὐ πάνυ τι ἐκφευξεῖσθαι), and s008 charts justice's movement from possible invisibility through stages of appearing to anticipated full visibility. The escape vocabulary and the visibility vocabulary together articulate the quarry's dual resistance: it can flee and it can hide.

The dense recurrence of ἐγγίγνομαι and ἔνειμι forms (s014: ἐγγενέσθαι, ἐγγενομένοις, ἐνῇ, ἐγγενόμενον, ἐγγενομένη, ἐνοῦσα, ἐνόν) describes each virtue coming to be in or being present in the city, while s015 identifies justice as τὸ ὑπόλοιπον, τὸ ὑπολειφθέν after finding the other three. The conjunction makes visible that justice's mode of presence differs from the other virtues: they are described as coming-to-be-in (ἐγγίγνομαι), justice is discovered as what-is-left (ὑπολείπω).

The seeing cluster (s002: κατιδεῖν, ἴδῃς, καθορᾶν, δεικνύμενα) and the leader-follower exchange (s010: ἕπου, ἡγοῦ, ἑπομένῳ, δεικνύμενα) share δεικνύμενα. Together they make visible that following is configured as seeing what is shown: Glaucon will follow and see τὰ δεικνύμενα, making the hunt a guided seeing rather than independent discovery.

The back-and-forth movement between city and individual (s018: ἐπαναφέρωμεν εἰς τὸν ἕνα, ἐπανιόντες ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν) is immediately followed by the fire-stick image (s013: παρʼ ἄλληλα σκοποῦντες καὶ τρίβοντες, ὥσπερ ἐκ πυρείων ἐκλάμψαι). The conjunction makes visible that the alternating movement between city and individual is not mere comparison but friction (τρίβοντες): rubbing them παρʼ ἄλληλα produces light.

elements.context: καὶ ἐγὼ κατιδών, ἰοὺ ἰού, εἶπον

new_signals.observation: Doubled hunting cry ἰοὺ ἰού immediately follows κατιδών, marking the moment of sighting the quarry's track (ἴχνος).

elements.context: ἦ μήν, ἦν δʼ ἐγώ, βλακικόν γε ἡμῶν τὸ πάθος

new_signals.observation: Socrates names their condition twice: βλακικόν (sluggish, stupid) and καταγελαστότατοι (most ridiculous), characterizing the failure to see what was πρὸ ποδῶν.

elements.context: πάλαι … φαίνεται πρὸ ποδῶν ἡμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς κυλινδεῖσθαι
καὶ λέγοντες αὐτὸ καὶ ἀκούοντες πάλαι

new_signals.observation: πάλαι appears twice describing the long-standing presence of justice (rolling at their feet πάλαι, speaking and hearing it πάλαι), while πάλιν marks the return movement to the city for testing.

elements.context: πρὸ ποδῶν ἡμῖν ἐξ ἀρχῆς κυλινδεῖσθαι

new_signals.observation: Justice has been rolling (κυλινδεῖσθαι) at their feet—a continuous motion contrasting with the static position πρὸ ποδῶν. The object they seek has been in continuous visible movement beneath their gaze.
The number three recurs: τὰ τρία virtues to be found first, τριῶν γενῶν whose πολυπραγμοσύνη constitutes injustice. The triadic structure appears in both virtue-discovery and class-configuration.

elements.context: ἐὰν μὲν ἡμῖν καὶ εἰς ἕνα ἕκαστον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἰὸν τὸ εἶδος τοῦτο ὁμολογῆται

new_signals.observation: ὁμολογέω appears three times marking points of potential agreement: justice as possession of one's own (ὁμολογοῖτο), the form going into the individual (ὁμολογῆται), and if it agrees in the individual (ὁμολογῆται, καλῶς ἕξει). Agreement itself is staged at multiple levels.
Glaucon's response to Socrates' hunting cry and track-sighting: εὖ ἀγγέλλεις (you bring good news). The hunt is also a message-bringing, the tracker an announcer.
